“The results show that Al has a great effect on as-cast structure,morphology and distribution of M2C in M2 high-speed steel,which changes the concentration of alloying element in the matrix and the carbide and the distribution of the carbides in the matrix,thus affects the morphology of carbides and the mechanical properties of the high speed steels”.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the morphology of eutectic M2C can be improved through the control of the distribution of alloyed elements and constitutional supercooling.
Al is not a suitable alloying element in M2 highspeed steel.
Al is not a good element for improving the carbide morphology in M2 high-speed steel.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the morphology of the eutectic phase is determined by the constitutional supercoolings in the solidifying melt,which are in turn determined by the solute concentration in the liquid.
the addition of Al can improve the microstructure and properties of M2C in high speed steel.
the presence of Al in the matrix can increase the concentration of alloying element in carbide phase,which is not beneficial to refine the M2C carbide.
